scope: Slay the Spire 1 facts relevant to cards and potion visibly offered during the current guided Ironclad run. Recommendation claims remain conditional.

claims.statement: Fiend Fire costs 2 Energy, Exhausts all other cards in hand, deals 7 damage for each card Exhausted this way, and then Exhausts itself; its upgrade deals 10 damage per card.
Perfected Strike costs 2 Energy and deals 6 damage plus 2 additional damage for every card in the deck whose name contains Strike. Cleave costs 1 Energy and deals 8 damage to all enemies.

Fiend Fire is a candidate finisher only when its expected damage, discarded hand, current energy, enemy intent, and any exhaust interactions are evaluated from the observed combat state; it is not an automatic play merely because it is in the deck.
claims.conditions: Requires a current, legible hand and enemy intents.
